safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting "No epipen available" introduces an unverified fact in a time-sensitive possible anaphylaxis scenario; if the patient actually had an epinephrine auto-injector, this could incorrectly reduce consideration of immediate self-administration while awaiting ambulance or mislead subsequent clinicians. Although the clinician appropriately advised calling an ambulance regardless, the incorrect note could still affect acute or follow-up management decisions.
